text: Simone is vegan now, properly, not just weekdays. Book somewhere with options for the team lunch end of the month.
Eilidh's allergic to tree nuts, carries an EpiPen. Keep that in mind for the Christmas do on 11 December 2026.
lunch w Mandla. his manager Ali is leaving early march, Mandla nervous about who replaces him. ask how the handover goes
Need to pick up the dry cleaning and renew car insurance sometime next week, before it lapses on 3 November 2026.
Anika mentioned her husband Tiago only drinks oat milk flat whites. Also he's doing Dry January, starting early this time, from mid December.

So Owen called, the client in Leeds pushed the pitch back to February 2027, which honestly is a relief for him because he's been really struggling with the deck and his manager keeps rewriting it overnight. He's also not sleeping great since the baby arrived. I should send him the old slides from last year so he isn't starting from scratch, and maybe offer to sit in on a dry run sometime in January.
Elijah coeliac. no regular pasta. remember for the dinner
Dentist moved to 14 January 2027. Car MOT due end of the month.
Tiago Costa from accounts goes by TC. Promoted to finance lead, starts in the new role after the summer. Send congrats.

Lior's sister Kiri is getting married over the summer, somewhere near Porto, and Lior's giving a speech and is absolutely terrified, he's never spoken in public. The hen do is in Lisbon early June. Kiri is gluten free and her fiance Bruno is vegan so the menu sounds like a headache. Lior says the rehearsal dinner is 4 July 2027. Should offer to listen to a draft of the speech sometime in the spring.
Lwazi says his boss is impossible, keeps moving deadlines. He's thinking about leaving by spring.
don't forget to ask Aiko how her performance review went, it was this morning
Carlos hates coriander. Like genuinely can't eat it, tastes like soap to him.
Karim and his wife Vanessa have their tenth anniversary on 2 November 2026. They're doing a long weekend in Rome. Maybe a card from the team?
I'm taking Thursday off and doing the big shop, then the tip run. Back on the laptop Friday.

Patrick's retirement drinks were cancelled, his mum's in hospital after a fall. He's flying to Cork tomorrow to be with her and doesn't know when he'll be back, probably not before the end of the month. His sister Ann is already over there. Must text him at the weekend to see how his mum is doing, and tell the team to hold the card until he's back.
Ann - pescatarian, no shellfish though. Loves a good Rioja.
chatted w Eduardo after standup. his daughter starts nursery in January 2027, he's dreading the drop-offs. also wife pregnant again!! due June
Tobi asked if we can move the client call to sometime next week. Fine by me.
Afua's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, a lump removed. She's knackered from being up with him. Check in later in the week.
Rafael is lactose intolerant, but fine with hard cheese apparently. Dropping hints about wanting a fancy espresso machine for his birthday in March.
Note to self. Book flights for the March 2027 conference in Lisbon before prices go up. Passport expires August 2027, fine.
Shreya Gupta, the new client lead, prefers decaf and hates long meetings. Keep updates under twenty minutes.

Andile got the job at the bank!! Starts 1 December 2026, head of compliance, which is huge for him after the year he's had. His wife Nia is thrilled, she said they'll finally book the honeymoon they never had, probably Zanzibar in March 2027. Need to take him out for a drink to celebrate, maybe early December, somewhere with decent whisky because that's his thing.
Luis mentioned his partner Bruno is cooking a massive paella for Luis's fortieth on Saturday 7 November. I'm bringing dessert.
Irina nervous about her driving test, it's sometime next week. Text her good luck the night before.

Okay so dictating this in the car. Dev from the Manchester office came down today and we ended up having lunch with Nia and Nikhil. Dev is keto, which made ordering a bit of a nightmare, and Nia's gone teetotal since her diagnosis in the spring, she doesn't want a fuss made. Nikhil's moving to the Bristol team at the end of the month and Dev's taking over his clients. I need to set up a handover meeting with the two of them before then.
Manon only drinks green tea, no milk. Get some in for when she visits the office 18 November.
Ali leaving drinks Friday at the Crown. Collection going round, chip in a tenner.
Groceries: oat milk, gluten free bread, eggs, coffee beans. Bins out Tuesday.
remind me to email Simone the revised quote before end of week

Eilidh's brother Owen has just been made redundant from the warehouse. She's really worried about him, he's got two kids and a mortgage and he's not coping brilliantly. Good news is he's got an interview with a logistics firm on 30 October 2026, and another possibly sometime next week. Eilidh asked if I knew anyone hiring in Glasgow. I'll ask around.
Mandla said his mum's turning seventy in early March 2027. Big family party in Durban, he's flying out for two weeks.
Anika's daughter has a severe egg allergy, so no cake from the bakery for her birthday bit at work. Anika will bring something herself.
Met the new hire, Elijah Adeyemi. Ex consultant, loves climbing, mad about hot sauce. Seems nice.
Tiago and his girlfriend are moving in together over the summer, looking at flats in Hackney now. Viewing a couple next Saturday.
Must get the boiler serviced before winter. Also call the council about the parking permit, expires 30 November 2026.
Lior's off for knee surgery on 9 December 2026, out for about six weeks. I should send something to the house, maybe some books, he loves sci-fi.
Kiri runs the Auckland account now. Big Formula 1 fan, supports Ferrari. Don't schedule anything on race Sundays lol
Lwazi Usman's leaving do was meant to be next Friday but he's postponed indefinitely, still negotiating his notice. Ask him how it's going sometime next week.
Aiko passed her CIMA exams! Results came out this morning. Congratulate her tomorrow at the team meeting.
Carlos and Vanessa are doing a joint birthday thing at their place on 21 November 2026, she said bring a bottle, Carlos loves a smoky mezcal.
Karim's cat Pepper went missing over the weekend. He's in bits.
meal prep sunday. gym mon wed fri. sort the tax return by 31 January 2027 at the latest, ideally sometime in December

Patrick from procurement - his wife Ann just had twins!! Last Tuesday, a boy and a girl, Leo and Rosa. Both healthy, Ann's recovering well but exhausted. Patrick's off on paternity leave until early January 2027. Get a card signed by the team and organise a gift, maybe nappies and a Deliveroo voucher since neither of them will be cooking any time soon. Patrick's a big tea drinker, Yorkshire Gold, could stick a box in.
Eduardo told me his manager Shreya is pushing him to go for the senior role. Applications close end of the month and the interview would be early December. He's not sure he wants the stress.
Tobi brought jollof for the potluck, unreal. He's vegetarian except fish, eats a lot of plantain. Said his grandma taught him.

Afua is doing the London Marathon in April 2027 for her brother's charity, and training's already going badly with her shin splints. Physio on 12 November 2026. She's quite down about it, keeps saying she'll pull out. Her husband Dev is doing a half in Brighton the same spring. Ask how training's going in a few weeks and maybe join her for a slow Sunday run.
Rafael's dad passed away on Monday. Funeral is in Porto sometime next week, he'll be off until the 9th. Need to send flowers from all of us and give him space.

Long call with Shreya this afternoon. Client wants the rollout brought forward from March 2027 to January, which is a big ask, and her boss isn't backing her at all. She sounded completely fried. She's also off to India over Christmas for her cousin's wedding, so anything that slips past 18 December is on me. Don't forget to check in with her on Friday and see if she wants me to take the stakeholder meetings.
Andile mentioned his wife Nia's exhibition opening 2 November 2026 at a gallery in Peckham. They both invited me. Bring something non-alcoholic, she's pregnant.
Luis - no red meat, mostly chicken and fish. Doesn't drink at all.
Bruno's son Dev has his grade 5 piano exam on 25 November, Bruno says he's a wreck about it. Could text Dev good luck through Bruno.
Order new running shoes, return the jacket. Haircut Saturday.
Irina Petrov, the auditor everyone dreads, is back sometime in early January. She takes her coffee black, no sugar, and she's allergic to peanuts. Make sure the meeting room has nothing with nuts.
Dev and his partner Nikhil just got engaged in Kyoto! Wedding probably over the summer 2027. Owen's organising a card.

Nia's been off sick for two weeks with long covid. Her manager Karim says she might go part time from early March, and HR are meeting her sometime next week to talk options. She's frustrated, she hates being away from the team and her kids are home all day over half term. I should give her a ring next week, nothing work related, and drop round some of that ginger soup she likes.
Manon told me her mum is having a hip replacement on 12 November 2026. Manon's taking a week off to look after her. She mentioned she'd love a decent cookbook, vegetarian, for the recovery downtime.
Ali's daughter Kiri graduates from Edinburgh in July 2027. He's beaming about it.
Big week. Monday dentist, Wednesday the quarterly review, then on Friday 6 November 2026 I'm driving up to my sister's. Pack Thursday night.
